title: A gateway release removed browser protections

incident.title: A gateway release removed browser protections
incident.before: CSP, nosniff and SameSite applied by the gateway
incident.how: PR #231 removed the response-hardening middleware from the gateway configuration. Release 412 changed the observed headers and cookie attributes on the same scoped routes.
incident.blast: Four observed response routes: /, /assets/, /login and /example-error. The header findings describe missing defenses; they do not establish XSS exploitation.
incident.prevention: Restore the gateway policy, deploy CSP in report-only mode where appropriate and retest the same routes with response-header regression checks.
incident.source: Gateway configuration diff + before/after HTTP observations + release manifest

content.summary: PR #231 removed the response-hardening middleware from the gateway configuration. Release 412 changed the observed headers and cookie attributes on the same scoped routes.
